A Möbius map has index 1 at every point. A polynomial has index natDegree(p) at ∞; at some(x), its index is the root multiplicity of x in p mapped to Q̄[X] minus the constant polynomial p(x). For a finite list h = [h₁,…,hₖ], F_h applies h₁ first and hₖ last. Thus F_[] is the identity and F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)). Its index is R_[]=1 and R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)); equivalently, multiply the elementary indices at successive images of z. Write P(h,A,t) for exactly these three conditions: every z ∈ A satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B; F_h(t) ∉ B; and every projective point z with 1 < R_h(z) satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B. For every list hs, sets S and S′, and point τ, suppose P(hs,S,τ) and S′⊆S. Then P(hs,S′,τ) holds for the same list and point.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ofRat`

对每个有理数 q，定义 ofRat(q) 为有限射影点 some(q)，其中使用有理数域到其完整代数闭包 Q̄ 的标准嵌入。射影点类型为 Option Q̄，none 表示无穷远点 ∞。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsGalStable`

对有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄ 的有限子集 T，定义 IsGalStable(T) 如下：对 Q̄ 的每个固定有理数的代数自同构 σ，以及每个 t∈T，都有 σ(t)∈T。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.deg`

对有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄ 中的每个元素 x，定义 deg(x) 为 x 在有理数域上的最小多项式的自然数次数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.withInf`

对 Q̄ 的有限子集 T，定义 withInf(T) 为射影点集合 {∞}∪{some(t):t∈T}。射影点类型为 Option Q̄，none 表示 ∞。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.none_mem_withInf`

对 Q̄ 的每个有限子集 T，无穷远点 ∞ 都属于 withInf(T)={∞}∪{some(t):t∈T}。这里 ∞ 是 Option Q̄ 中的 none。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.some_mem_withInf`

对 Q̄ 的每个有限子集 T 和每个 t∈Q̄，若 t∈T，则有限射影点 some(t) 属于 withInf(T)={∞}∪{some(x):x∈T}。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ι`

定义 ι 为从有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄ 到复数域的一个固定有理数代数同态。定义先局部提供 Q̄ 在有理数域上为代数扩张的实例，再使用 IsAlgClosed.lift 选取该同态。域同态 ι 是嵌入。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ι_ratCast`

对每个有理数 q，固定的有理数代数嵌入 ι:Q̄→ℂ 把 q 在 Q̄ 中的标准像映到 q 在复数域中的标准像，即 ι((q:Q̄))=(q:ℂ)。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.norm_ι_ratCast`

对每个有理数 q，其在固定有理数代数嵌入 ι:Q̄→ℂ 下的像的复数范数等于 q 的实数绝对值，即 ‖ι((q:Q̄))‖=|(q:ℝ)|。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsNoncriticalBelyi`

取有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄。射影点是无穷远点 ∞，或者有限点 some(x)，其中 x∈Q̄。指定集合为 B={∞,some(0),some(1)}。初等映射有两类：有理系数的 Möbius 映射 (az+b)/(cz+d)，其中 a,b,c,d∈ℚ 且 ad−bc≠0；以及有理系数多项式 p，其自然数次数严格大于零。Möbius 映射在有限点的分母为零时取值 ∞；在 ∞ 处，当 c=0 时取值 ∞，否则取值 some(a/c)。多项式把 some(x) 映到 some(p(x))，把 ∞ 映到 ∞。Möbius 映射在每一点的分歧指数为 1。多项式在 ∞ 的分歧指数为其自然数次数；在 some(x) 的分歧指数为 x 在多项式 p 的系数嵌入 Q̄ 后减去常数多项式 p(x) 所得多项式中的根重数。对有限列表 h=[h₁,…,hₖ]，复合 F_h 先作用 h₁，最后作用 hₖ。因此 F_[] 为恒等映射，F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z))。复合分歧指数满足 R_[]=1 和 R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z))，即沿逐次像相乘。记 P(h,A,t) 为以下三个条件的合取：每个 z∈A 都满足 F_h(z)∈B；F_h(t)∉B；每个满足 1<R_h(z) 的射影点 z 都满足 F_h(z)∈B。对上述初等映射的每个有限列表 hs、射影点的每个集合 S，以及每个射影点 τ，定义 IsNoncriticalBelyi(hs,S,τ) 为 P(hs,S,τ)，即上述三个条件的合取。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsNoncriticalBelyi.mono`

取有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄。射影点是无穷远点 ∞，或者有限点 some(x)，其中 x∈Q̄。指定集合为 B={∞,some(0),some(1)}。初等映射有两类：有理系数的 Möbius 映射 (az+b)/(cz+d)，其中 a,b,c,d∈ℚ 且 ad−bc≠0；以及有理系数多项式 p，其自然数次数严格大于零。Möbius 映射在有限点的分母为零时取值 ∞；在 ∞ 处，当 c=0 时取值 ∞，否则取值 some(a/c)。多项式把 some(x) 映到 some(p(x))，把 ∞ 映到 ∞。Möbius 映射在每一点的分歧指数为 1。多项式在 ∞ 的分歧指数为其自然数次数；在 some(x) 的分歧指数为 x 在多项式 p 的系数嵌入 Q̄ 后减去常数多项式 p(x) 所得多项式中的根重数。对有限列表 h=[h₁,…,hₖ]，复合 F_h 先作用 h₁，最后作用 hₖ。因此 F_[] 为恒等映射，F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z))。复合分歧指数满足 R_[]=1 和 R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z))，即沿逐次像相乘。记 P(h,A,t) 为以下三个条件的合取：每个 z∈A 都满足 F_h(z)∈B；F_h(t)∉B；每个满足 1<R_h(z) 的射影点 z 都满足 F_h(z)∈B。对每个列表 hs、集合 S 与 S′ 以及点 τ，若 P(hs,S,τ) 成立且 S′⊆S，则同一个列表和同一个点满足 P(hs,S′,τ)。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ofRat`

各有理数 q に対し、ofRat(q) を、標準埋め込み ℚ→Q̄ による有限射影点 some(q) と定義する。射影点の型は Option Q̄ であり、none は無限遠点 ∞ を表す。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsGalStable`

有理数体の全代数閉包 Q̄ の有限部分集合 T に対し、IsGalStable(T) を次の命題として定義する。Q̄ のすべての ℚ-代数自己同型 σ とすべての t∈T に対して σ(t)∈T が成り立つ。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.deg`

有理数体の全代数閉包 Q̄ の各元 x に対し、deg(x) を x の ℚ 上の最小多項式の自然数次数と定義する。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.withInf`

Q̄ の有限部分集合 T に対し、withInf(T) を射影点集合 {∞}∪{some(t):t∈T} と定義する。射影点の型は Option Q̄ であり、none は ∞ を表す。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.none_mem_withInf`

Q̄ のすべての有限部分集合 T に対し、無限遠点 ∞ は withInf(T)={∞}∪{some(t):t∈T} に属する。ここで ∞ は Option Q̄ の none である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.some_mem_withInf`

Q̄ のすべての有限部分集合 T とすべての t∈Q̄ に対し、t∈T ならば有限射影点 some(t) は withInf(T)={∞}∪{some(x):x∈T} に属する。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ι`

ι を、有理数体の全代数閉包 Q̄ から複素数体への固定した ℚ-代数準同型として定義する。定義内では Q̄ が ℚ 上代数的であるという局所インスタンスを与え、IsAlgClosed.lift を用いる。体準同型であるため、ι は埋め込みである。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ι_ratCast`

すべての有理数 q に対し、固定した ℚ-代数埋め込み ι:Q̄→ℂ は Q̄ における q の標準像を複素数体における q の標準像に写す。すなわち ι((q:Q̄))=(q:ℂ) である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.norm_ι_ratCast`

すべての有理数 q に対し、固定した ℚ-代数埋め込み ι:Q̄→ℂ による像の複素数ノルムは q の実数としての絶対値に等しい。すなわち ‖ι((q:Q̄))‖=|(q:ℝ)| である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsNoncriticalBelyi`

有理数体の全代数閉包を Q̄ とする。射影点は無限遠点 ∞ または有限点 some(x)（x∈Q̄）である。指定集合を B={∞,some(0),some(1)} とする。初等写像は、有理数係数のメビウス変換 (az+b)/(cz+d)（a,b,c,d∈ℚ、ad−bc≠0）、または自然数次数が正の有理数係数多項式 p のいずれかである。メビウス変換は有限点で分母が零なら ∞ を与え、∞ では c=0 なら ∞、そうでなければ some(a/c) を与える。多項式は some(x) を some(p(x)) に、∞ を ∞ に写す。メビウス変換の分岐指数は各点で 1 である。多項式の分岐指数は ∞ でその自然数次数、some(x) では p の係数を Q̄ に移した多項式から定数多項式 p(x) を引いた多項式における x の根の重複度である。有限リスト h=[h₁,…,hₖ] の合成 F_h は h₁ を最初に、hₖ を最後に作用させる。従って F_[] は恒等写像であり、F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)) となる。合成分岐指数は R_[]=1、R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)) であり、逐次得られる像での指数を掛け合わせる。P(h,A,t) は次の三条件の連言を表す。A の各点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。F_h(t)∉B が成り立つ。さらに、1<R_h(z) を満たすすべての射影点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。上記の初等写像のすべての有限リスト hs、射影点のすべての集合 S、およびすべての射影点 τ に対し、IsNoncriticalBelyi(hs,S,τ) を P(hs,S,τ)、すなわち上記三条件の連言として定義する。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsNoncriticalBelyi.mono`

有理数体の全代数閉包を Q̄ とする。射影点は無限遠点 ∞ または有限点 some(x)（x∈Q̄）である。指定集合を B={∞,some(0),some(1)} とする。初等写像は、有理数係数のメビウス変換 (az+b)/(cz+d)（a,b,c,d∈ℚ、ad−bc≠0）、または自然数次数が正の有理数係数多項式 p のいずれかである。メビウス変換は有限点で分母が零なら ∞ を与え、∞ では c=0 なら ∞、そうでなければ some(a/c) を与える。多項式は some(x) を some(p(x)) に、∞ を ∞ に写す。メビウス変換の分岐指数は各点で 1 である。多項式の分岐指数は ∞ でその自然数次数、some(x) では p の係数を Q̄ に移した多項式から定数多項式 p(x) を引いた多項式における x の根の重複度である。有限リスト h=[h₁,…,hₖ] の合成 F_h は h₁ を最初に、hₖ を最後に作用させる。従って F_[] は恒等写像であり、F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)) となる。合成分岐指数は R_[]=1、R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)) であり、逐次得られる像での指数を掛け合わせる。P(h,A,t) は次の三条件の連言を表す。A の各点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。F_h(t)∉B が成り立つ。さらに、1<R_h(z) を満たすすべての射影点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。すべてのリスト hs、集合 S、S′ および点 τ に対し、P(hs,S,τ) と S′⊆S を仮定する。このとき同じリストと点について P(hs,S′,τ) が成り立つ。

Authors: The Belyi project contributors

Independent namespace adaptation of Belyi/NoncriticalP1/ElemMap.lean, Analytic.lean, Reduction.lean.
Pinned Belyi: 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8.
Upstream: https://github.com/lana-agents/belyi.
Source SHA-256: ElemMap=5a39ddb83c19b37af76e573f522463e7baa167cd4dbce8a90c9c3a8d173c63a5; Analytic=32ac8aca84e7cfe15e10dab7ca99781a664ed0c44e32ea80906d538e1cb2c4d1; Reduction=097aace5620aa31d0eb75b0f976cffff02d655ebcd3c15fd6cee9726f101bc53.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatNoncriticalFunctions
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Polynomial.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Option
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1

/-- Source `ofRat`, on the existing concrete projective-line type. -/
noncomputable def ofRat (q : ℚ) : Pt := some (q : Tripod.Qbar)

/-- All automorphisms of the full algebraic closure are quantified. -/
def IsGalStable (T : Finset Tripod.Qbar) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ : Tripod.Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Tripod.Qbar, ∀ t ∈ T, σ t ∈ T

/-- Source degree over ℚ, without replacing algebraic points by rational points. -/
noncomputable abbrev deg (x : Tripod.Qbar) : ℕ := (minpoly ℚ x).natDegree

/-- Source branch set, including the point at infinity. -/
def withInf (T : Finset Tripod.Qbar) : Set Pt := insert none (some '' (T : Set Tripod.Qbar))

@[simp] theorem none_mem_withInf (T : Finset Tripod.Qbar) : (none : Pt) ∈ withInf T :=
  Set.mem_insert _ _

theorem some_mem_withInf {T : Finset Tripod.Qbar} {t : Tripod.Qbar} (ht : t ∈ T) :
    some t ∈ withInf T :=
  Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

/-- Source fixed complex embedding, not an assumed norm law. -/
noncomputable def ι : Tripod.Qbar →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ :=
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ Tripod.Qbar := AlgebraicClosure.isAlgebraic ℚ
  IsAlgClosed.lift

@[simp] theorem ι_ratCast (q : ℚ) : ι (q : Tripod.Qbar) = (q : ℂ) := map_ratCast ι q

@[simp] theorem norm_ι_ratCast (q : ℚ) : ‖ι (q : Tripod.Qbar)‖ = |(q : ℝ)| := by
  rw [ι_ratCast, ← Complex.ofReal_ratCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- A transparent conjunction of the exact three source conditions. Every
function here is the existing evaluation or ramification function of a list
of actual rational elementary maps. -/
def IsNoncriticalBelyi (hs : List ElemMap) (S : Set Pt) (τ : Pt) : Prop :=
  (∀ z ∈ S, evalComp hs z ∈ zeroOneInf) ∧
  evalComp hs τ ∉ zeroOneInf ∧
  (∀ z, 1 < ramIdxComp hs z → evalComp hs z ∈ zeroOneInf)

namespace IsNoncriticalBelyi

theorem mono {hs : List ElemMap} {S S' : Set Pt} {τ : Pt}
    (hg : IsNoncriticalBelyi hs S τ) (hS : S' ⊆ S) : IsNoncriticalBelyi hs S' τ :=
  ⟨fun z hz => hg.1 z (hS hz), hg.2.1, hg.2.2⟩

end IsNoncriticalBelyi

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1
nodes.source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Noncritical Belyi Maps (May 2004), section 2, Lemmas 2.1–2.4 and the P¹ case of Theorem 2.5, https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Noncritical%20Belyi%20Maps.pdf . The checked quotation records the source context. The paper uses reduced degrees and its own constants; the precise degree/count continuation contracts and fixed constant 9 belong to the pinned Lean implementation. This unit adapts the concrete Belyi/NoncriticalP1 definitions, reduction contracts and nested induction from lana-agents/belyi at 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8, pinned by refer/iut/lake-manifest.json. Source files retain their Apache-2.0 headers and author notices. The three source reduction steps remain Open. This is a decomposition of the unchanged parent, not direct proof closure. No Belyi, Heights, Iut, or Genl runtime dependency is added. Belyi/NoncriticalP1/ElemMap.lean, Analytic.lean and Reduction.lean: actual rational-point inclusion, all-Qbar Galois stability, minpoly degree, finite branch set with actual infinity, actual complex algebra embedding, and the three concrete noncritical-Belyi conditions. The existing rational ElemMap constructors, evaluation and ramification functions are reused unchanged. Definitions import no Open theorem.

nodes.theorem_title: FermatRiemannLocalDimension — actual function-field geometry
nodes.natural_language_statement:
> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.riemann_coe_ratHom`

The map ratHom P:ℚ→O_P is the canonical rational embedding with codomain restricted to O_P. Let K be any field of characteristic zero. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). Let P be any such place. For every q∈ℚ, the image in K of ratHom P q∈O_P equals q.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.riemann_residue_ratHom`

The map ratHom P:ℚ→O_P is the canonical rational embedding with codomain restricted to O_P. Let K be any field of characteristic zero. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). Let P be any such place. For every q∈ℚ, the residue of ratHom P q equals the canonical image of q in κ(P).

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.RiemannDimension.mem_L`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Also supply a curve-field instance, meaning that there exists s∈K transcendental over ℚ with K finite-dimensional over ℚ(s). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. For every divisor A and f∈M.K, f∈L(A) if and only if f=0 or −A(P)≤P.ord(f) at every place P.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.RiemannDimension.mem_L_of_ne_zero`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Also supply a curve-field instance, meaning that there exists s∈K transcendental over ℚ with K finite-dimensional over ℚ(s). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. For every place P, m∈ℕ and divisor A, if L(A) is finite-dimensional over ℚ, then L(A+m[P]) is finite-dimensional over ℚ and ℓ(A+m[P])≤ℓ(A)+m[κ(P):ℚ], with finranks cast to integers in the inequality.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.riemann_coe_ratHom`

写像 ratHom P:ℚ→O_P は、有理数の標準的な埋め込みの終域を O_P に制限したものである。K を任意の標数零の体とする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。P をこのような任意の素点とする。任意の有理数 q に対し、ratHom P q∈O_P の K における像は q と等しい。

import Definitions.Def_FermatFunctionDivisors

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

namespace Place

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (P : Place K)

@[simp] theorem riemann_coe_ratHom (q : ℚ) : (P.ratHom q : K) = q := rfl

@[simp] theorem riemann_residue_ratHom (q : ℚ) :
    P.residue (P.ratHom q) = (q : P.ResidueField) :=
  map_ratCast (P.residue.comp P.ratHom) q

end Place

namespace RiemannDimension

open IsLocalRing

variable {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
variable [hCurve : IsCurveField M.K]
include M hDVR hCurve

local notation "L" => riemannRochSpace M hDVR
local notation "ell" => riemannEll M hDVR
local notation "pdiv" => functionDivisor M hDVR
local notation "degree" => divisorDegree M

theorem mem_L {A : Divisor M} {f : M.K} : f ∈ L A ↔ f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place M.K, -A P ≤ P.ord f :=
  by
  simp only [mem_riemannRochSpace, ord_eq_placeOrd]

theorem mem_L_of_ne_zero {A : Divisor M} {f : M.K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ L A ↔ 0 ≤ A + pdiv f := by
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf]
  refine forall_congr' fun P ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd]
  omega

theorem L_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) : L A ≤ L B :=
  riemannRochSpace_mono M hDVR h

/-! ### Transport along principal divisors -/

theorem mul_mem_L {A : Divisor M} {z f : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hf : f ∈ L (A + pdiv z)) :
    f * z ∈ L A := by
  rw [mem_L] at hf ⊢
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd] at this
  rw [P.ord_mul hf0 hz]
  omega

theorem mul_inv_mem_L {A : Divisor M} {z g : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hg : g ∈ L A) :
    g * z⁻¹ ∈ L (A + pdiv z) := by
  rw [mem_L] at hg ⊢
  rcases hg with rfl | hg
  · simp
  by_cases hg0 : g = 0
  · simp [hg0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hg P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd]
  rw [P.ord_mul hg0 (inv_ne_zero hz), P.ord_inv]
  omega

/-- Multiplication by `z ≠ 0` identifies `L(A + pdiv z)` with `L(A)`. -/
noncomputable def mulEquiv (A : Divisor M) {z : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) : L (A + pdiv z) ≃ₗ[ℚ] L A where
  toFun f := ⟨f * z, mul_mem_L M hDVR hz f.2⟩
  invFun g := ⟨g * z⁻¹, mul_inv_mem_L M hDVR hz g.2⟩
  map_add' f g := Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _)
  map_smul' q f := Subtype.ext (smul_mul_assoc _ _ _)
  left_inv f := Subtype.ext (by simp [hz])
  right_inv g := Subtype.ext (by simp [hz])

/-- `ℓ` is invariant under linear equivalence. -/
theorem ell_add_pdiv (A : Divisor M) {z : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) : ell (A + pdiv z) = ell A :=
  (mulEquiv M hDVR A hz).finrank_eq

/-! ### Adding a place -/

section Step

variable {A : Divisor M} {P : Place M.K} {π : M.K}

theorem ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one (hπ : P.ord π = 1) : π ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl; simp at hπ

theorem zpow_mul_mem (hπ : P.ord π = 1) {f : M.K} (hf : f ∈ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    π ^ (A P + 1) * f ∈ P.1 := by
  rw [mem_L] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  apply P.mem_of_ord_nonneg
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ (ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one M hDVR hπ)) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ]
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
  omega

variable (A P) in
/-- The `ℚ`-linear map `L(A + P) → κ(P)`, `f ↦ (π^{A(P)+1} f)(P)`. -/
noncomputable def residueMap (hπ : P.ord π = 1) :
    L (A + Finsupp.single P 1) →ₗ[ℚ] P.ResidueField where
  toFun f := P.residue ⟨π ^ (A P + 1) * f, zpow_mul_mem M hDVR hπ f.2⟩
  map_add' f g := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [mul_add]
  map_smul' q f := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, Rat.smul_def q (P.residue _), ← P.riemann_residue_ratHom q, ← map_mul]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [SetLike.val_smul, Rat.smul_def, MulMemClass.coe_mul, Place.riemann_coe_ratHom]
    ring

theorem mem_ker_residueMap (hπ : P.ord π = 1) (f : L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    f ∈ LinearMap.ker (residueMap M hDVR A P hπ) ↔ (f : M.K) ∈ L A := by
  classical
  have hπ0 := ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one M hDVR hπ
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change P.residue _ = 0 ↔ _
  rw [P.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  by_cases hf0 : (f : M.K) = 0
  · simp only [hf0, mul_zero]
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ Or.inl rfl, fun _ ↦ by
      rw [show (⟨0, _⟩ : P.1) = 0 from rfl]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _⟩
  have hne : π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : M.K) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0
  rw [← P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨_, zpow_mul_mem M hDVR hπ f.2⟩) hne]
  change 0 < P.ord (π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : M.K)) ↔ _
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ, mem_L, or_iff_right hf0]
  have hf := f.2
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf0] at hf
  constructor
  · intro h Q
    by_cases hQ : Q = P
    · subst hQ; omega
    · have := hf Q
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hQ),
        add_zero] at this
      exact this
  · intro h
    have := h P
    omega

/-- **Adding a place** (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.8): if `L(A)` is finite-dimensional, so is
`L(A + P)`, and `ℓ(A + P) ≤ ℓ(A) + deg P`. -/
theorem step (A : Divisor M) (P : Place M.K) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) ∧
      ell (A + Finsupp.single P 1) ≤ ell A + P.degree := by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := P.exists_ord_eq_one
  set φ := residueMap M hDVR A P hπ
  have hle : L A ≤ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1) :=
    L_mono M hDVR (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one))
  have hker : LinearMap.ker φ = (L A).comap (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)).subtype := by
    ext f
    exact mem_ker_residueMap M hDVR hπ f
  let e : LinearMap.ker φ ≃ₗ[ℚ] L A :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hker).trans (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle)
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) := e.symm.finiteDimensional
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) := by
    refine ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker φ ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
    · rw [top_inf_eq]
      exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (inferInstance : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ))
  letI := hfin
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range φ) ≤ P.degree := Submodule.finrank_le _
  rw [e.finrank_eq] at h1
  unfold riemannEll
  omega

theorem step_nat (P : Place M.K) (m : ℕ) (A : Divisor M) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))) ∧
      (ell (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + m * P.degree := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    letI := h1
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := step M hDVR (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) P
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, Finsupp.single_add, ← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    have : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * P.degree = m * P.degree + P.degree := by ring
    omega

theorem aux (D : Divisor M) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (A : Divisor M) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + D)) ∧ (ell (A + D) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + (degree D) := by
  classical
  induction D using Finsupp.induction generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    rw [add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | single_add P b f hPf _ ih =>
    have hfP : f P = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hPf
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := by
      have := hD P
      simpa [hfP] using this
    have hf : 0 ≤ f := by
      intro Q
      by_cases hQ : Q = P
      · subst hQ; simp [hfP]
      · have := hD Q
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hQ] using this
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := step_nat M hDVR P m A
    letI := h1
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ih hf (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))
    rw [← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    rw [divisorDegree_add, divisorDegree_single]
    omega

end Step

/-! ### Finite-dimensionality and the dimension estimate -/

section PrincipalDegree

variable (hDegreeZero : ∀ f : M.K,
  divisorDegree M (functionDivisor M hDVR f) = 0)
include hDegreeZero

theorem negativeSpace {A : Divisor M} (hA : degree A < 0) : L A = ⊥ := by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro f hf
  have hfzero : f = 0 := by
    by_contra hf0
    have hnonneg := divisorDegree_nonneg M ((mem_L_of_ne_zero M hDVR hf0).mp hf)
    have hadd := divisorDegree_add M A (functionDivisor M hDVR f)
    have hzero := hDegreeZero f
    change 0 ≤ divisorDegree M (A + functionDivisor M hDVR f) at hnonneg
    omega
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).mpr hfzero

/-- Every Riemann–Roch space is finite-dimensional (Stichtenoth, Proposition 1.4.9). -/
theorem finiteDimensional_L (A : Divisor M) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A) := by
  obtain P0 : Place M.K := Classical.arbitrary _
  set n : ℤ := |(degree A)| + 1
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := by positivity
  have hdeg : degree (A - Finsupp.single P0 n) < 0 := by
    rw [divisorDegree_sub, divisorDegree_single]
    have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ P0.degree := by exact_mod_cast P0.degree_pos
    have h2 := le_abs_self (degree A)
    nlinarith
  have hbot := negativeSpace M hDVR hDegreeZero hdeg
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A - Finsupp.single P0 n)) := by
    rw [hbot]; infer_instance
  letI := this
  have := (aux M hDVR (Finsupp.single P0 n) (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr hn)
    (A - Finsupp.single P0 n)).1
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

/-- **Dimension estimate** (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.8): for `A ≤ B`,
`ℓ(B) ≤ ℓ(A) + (deg B - deg A)`. -/
theorem ell_le_of_le {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (ell B : ℤ) ≤ ell A + ((degree B) - (degree A)) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero A
  have := (aux M hDVR (B - A) (sub_nonneg.mpr h) A).2
  rwa [add_sub_cancel, divisorDegree_sub] at this

/-- For `A ≤ B`, `deg A - ℓ(A) ≤ deg B - ℓ(B)`. -/
theorem degreeDefect_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (degree A) - ell A ≤ (degree B) - ell B := by
  have := ell_le_of_le M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  omega

theorem ell_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) : ell A ≤ ell B := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero B
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (L_mono M hDVR h)

theorem ell_eq_zero_of_deg_neg {A : Divisor M} (hA : (degree A) < 0) : ell A = 0 := by
  rw [riemannEll, negativeSpace M hDVR hDegreeZero hA, finrank_bot]

theorem ell_eq_zero_iff {A : Divisor M} : ell A = 0 ↔ L A = ⊥ := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero A
  exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero

theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_L {A : Divisor M} (h : ell A ≠ 0) : ∃ f ∈ L A, f ≠ 0 :=
  (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp (mt (ell_eq_zero_iff M hDVR hDegreeZero).mpr h)

/-- If `L(A) ≠ 0`, then `A` is linearly equivalent to an effective divisor. -/
theorem exists_nonneg_add_pdiv {A : Divisor M} (h : ell A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : M.K, z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ A + pdiv z := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := exists_ne_zero_mem_L M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  exact ⟨z, hz0, (mem_L_of_ne_zero M hDVR hz0).mp hz⟩

/-- `ℓ(A) ≤ max 0 (deg A + ℓ(0))` (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.10). -/
theorem ell_le_max (A : Divisor M) : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ max 0 ((degree A) + ell (0 : Divisor M)) := by
  by_cases h : ell A = 0
  · rw [h]; exact le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hA⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_pdiv M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  have := ell_le_of_le M hDVR hDegreeZero hA
  rw [ell_add_pdiv M hDVR A hz, divisorDegree_add, hDegreeZero, divisorDegree_zero] at this
  exact (by omega : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ (degree A) + ell (0 : Divisor M)).trans (le_max_right _ _)


end PrincipalDegree

end RiemannDimension

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

nodes.theorem_title: FermatNoncriticalSimpleZeros — actual noncritical function constructions
nodes.natural_language_statement:
> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.SimpleZeroFunction`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ between $ℚ$ and the fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field $ℚ(t)$ in an indeterminate $t$, and elements $u,v∈K$, such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$ (no nonzero polynomial over $ℚ$ vanishes at $u$), $u^N+v^N=1$, the subfield generated by $ℚ,u,v$ is $K$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over the subfield $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. There is no separate restriction on $N$; the assertion concerns supplied data satisfying all these conditions. For $N=0$ the equation would be $1+1=1$ in characteristic zero, so no such model is supplied and assertions conditional on it are vacuous. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; $κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ is its residue field, with $𝔪_P$ the maximal ideal of $O_P$. Assume $h_{DVR}$: every such $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring. Write $v_P(f)$ for minus the integer logarithm of its maximal-ideal valuation at $f$, the normalized integer order with the total-function convention $v_P(0)=0$. For every finite set $T$ of places, this defines the type of data $(ψ,T′)$ where $ψ∈K$ is transcendental over $ℚ$ (no nonzero rational polynomial vanishes at $ψ$), $T′$ is a nonempty finite set of places, $T⊆T′$, every $P∈T′$ satisfies $v_P(ψ)=1$, and every $P∉T′$ satisfies $v_P(ψ)≤0$, together with proofs of these conditions. The requested set $T$ may be empty; $T′$ must still be nonempty.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.model_infinite_places`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ between $ℚ$ and the fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field $ℚ(t)$ in an indeterminate $t$, and elements $u,v∈K$, such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$ (no nonzero polynomial over $ℚ$ vanishes at $u$), $u^N+v^N=1$, the subfield generated by $ℚ,u,v$ is $K$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over the subfield $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. There is no separate restriction on $N$; the assertion concerns supplied data satisfying all these conditions. For $N=0$ the equation would be $1+1=1$ in characteristic zero, so no such model is supplied and assertions conditional on it are vacuous. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; $κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ is its residue field, with $𝔪_P$ the maximal ideal of $O_P$. The type of all these places of $K$ is infinite. This quantifies over the full proper valuation-subring carrier rather than a chosen affine chart; no discrete-valuation or residue-finiteness hypothesis is separately required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.simpleZeroFunction_of_polarRealization`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ between $ℚ$ and the fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field $ℚ(t)$ in an indeterminate $t$, and elements $u,v∈K$, such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$ (no nonzero polynomial over $ℚ$ vanishes at $u$), $u^N+v^N=1$, the subfield generated by $ℚ,u,v$ is $K$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over the subfield $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. There is no separate restriction on $N$; the assertion concerns supplied data satisfying all these conditions. For $N=0$ the equation would be $1+1=1$ in characteristic zero, so no such model is supplied and assertions conditional on it are vacuous. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; $κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ is its residue field, with $𝔪_P$ the maximal ideal of $O_P$. Assume $h_{DVR}$: every such $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring. Write $v_P(f)$ for minus the integer logarithm of its maximal-ideal valuation at $f$, the normalized integer order with the total-function convention $v_P(0)=0$. For a finite set of places $T$, a simple-zero datum consists of $ψ∈K$ transcendental over $ℚ$, a nonempty finite set $T′$ containing $T$, the equalities $v_P(ψ)=1$ for every $P∈T′$, and the inequalities $v_P(ψ)≤0$ for every $P∉T′$. Assume there exists an integer $n_1$ such that every finitely supported integer function $A$ on the places with $A(P)≥0$ for all $P$ and $n_1≤\sum_P A(P)[κ(P):ℚ]$ is realized by an element $f∈K$ with $\max(0,-v_P(f))=A(P)$ at every place; the degree $[κ(P):ℚ]$ is the finite vector-space dimension. Then for every finite set $T$ of places there exists at least one simple-zero datum of the specified kind. Neither $n_1$ nor $T$ is required to be positive or nonempty respectively.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.SimpleZeroFunction`

设 $N$ 为自然数，$M$ 包含 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ(t)$（$t$ 为不定元）的固定代数闭包之间的中间域 $K$，以及 $u,v∈K$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越（没有非零有理系数多项式在 $u$ 处为零）、$u^N+v^N=1$、由 $ℚ,u,v$ 生成的子域为整个 $K$，且 $K$ 在子域 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维、维数恰为 $N$。没有另外限制 $N$；断言仅涉及满足全部这些条件的给定数据。$N=0$ 时方程将成为特征零域中的 $1+1=1$，因而不存在这样的模型，以此为前提的断言是空真的。 处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P⊊K$；$κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ 是其余域，其中 $𝔪_P$ 为 $O_P$ 的极大理想。 假设 $h_{DVR}$：每个这样的 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环。记 $v_P(f)$ 为其极大理想赋值在 $f$ 处的整数对数的相反数，即规范化整数阶数，并采用全函数约定 $v_P(0)=0$。 对每个处的有限集合 $T$，此定义给出数据 $(ψ,T′)$ 及相关证明组成的类型，其中 $ψ∈K$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越（没有非零有理系数多项式在 $ψ$ 处为零），$T′$ 为处的非空有限集合，$T⊆T′$，每个 $P∈T′$ 满足 $v_P(ψ)=1$，每个 $P∉T′$ 满足 $v_P(ψ)≤0$。指定集合 $T$ 可以为空，但 $T′$ 仍须非空。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.model_infinite_places`

设 $N$ 为自然数，$M$ 包含 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ(t)$（$t$ 为不定元）的固定代数闭包之间的中间域 $K$，以及 $u,v∈K$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越（没有非零有理系数多项式在 $u$ 处为零）、$u^N+v^N=1$、由 $ℚ,u,v$ 生成的子域为整个 $K$，且 $K$ 在子域 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维、维数恰为 $N$。没有另外限制 $N$；断言仅涉及满足全部这些条件的给定数据。$N=0$ 时方程将成为特征零域中的 $1+1=1$，因而不存在这样的模型，以此为前提的断言是空真的。 处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P⊊K$；$κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ 是其余域，其中 $𝔪_P$ 为 $O_P$ 的极大理想。 $K$ 的所有这些处组成的类型是无限的。所用范围为全部真赋值子环，而非某个选定仿射图中的处；没有另行要求离散赋值或余域有限性假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.simpleZeroFunction_of_polarRealization`

设 $N$ 为自然数，$M$ 包含 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ(t)$（$t$ 为不定元）的固定代数闭包之间的中间域 $K$，以及 $u,v∈K$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越（没有非零有理系数多项式在 $u$ 处为零）、$u^N+v^N=1$、由 $ℚ,u,v$ 生成的子域为整个 $K$，且 $K$ 在子域 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维、维数恰为 $N$。没有另外限制 $N$；断言仅涉及满足全部这些条件的给定数据。$N=0$ 时方程将成为特征零域中的 $1+1=1$，因而不存在这样的模型，以此为前提的断言是空真的。 处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P⊊K$；$κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ 是其余域，其中 $𝔪_P$ 为 $O_P$ 的极大理想。 假设 $h_{DVR}$：每个这样的 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环。记 $v_P(f)$ 为其极大理想赋值在 $f$ 处的整数对数的相反数，即规范化整数阶数，并采用全函数约定 $v_P(0)=0$。 对处的有限集合 $T$，单零点数据包含在 $ℚ$ 上超越的 $ψ∈K$、包含 $T$ 的非空有限集合 $T′$，并满足每个 $P∈T′$ 都有 $v_P(ψ)=1$，每个 $P∉T′$ 都有 $v_P(ψ)≤0$。 假设存在整数 $n_1$，使处上的每个有限支撑整数函数 $A$，只要对所有 $P$ 有 $A(P)≥0$ 且 $n_1≤\sum_P A(P)[κ(P):ℚ]$，就存在 $f∈K$，使每个处都满足 $\max(0,-v_P(f))=A(P)$；次数 $[κ(P):ℚ]$ 是有限向量空间维数。则对每个处的有限集合 $T$，至少存在一个上述单零点数据。不要求 $n_1$ 为正，也不要求 $T$ 非空。

import Definitions.Def_FermatNoncriticalFunctions
import Definitions.Def_FermatRiemannComposition

set_option autoImplicit false

open Polynomial
open scoped Classical

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

variable {N : ℕ}

/-- An actual rational function with simple zeros exactly at a finite set
T' containing the requested places. Every place outside T' has order ≤0. -/
structure SimpleZeroFunction (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (T : Finset (Place M.K)) where
  ψ : M.K
  transcendental : Transcendental ℚ ψ
  T' : Finset (Place M.K)
  contains : T ⊆ T'
  nonempty : T'.Nonempty
  simple : ∀ P ∈ T', ord M hDVR P ψ = 1
  no_other_zeros : ∀ P ∉ T', ord M hDVR P ψ ≤ 0

theorem model_infinite_places (M : Model N) : Infinite (Place M.K) := by
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  let t := M.u
  have ht : Transcendental ℚ t := M.transcendental_u
  have hq : ∀ q : ℚ, Transcendental ℚ (t - algebraMap ℚ M.K q) := fun q => by
    have := ht.aeval (X - C q) (by rw [natDegree_X_sub_C]; exact one_ne_zero)
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (X_sub_C_ne_zero q)))
    simpa using this
  choose P hP using fun q => Place.exists_ord_pos (hq q)
  refine Infinite.of_injective P fun q q' hqq' => ?_
  by_contra hne
  have h1 := hP q
  have h2 := hP q'
  rw [← hqq'] at h2
  have hsum : (t - algebraMap ℚ M.K q) + -(t - algebraMap ℚ M.K q') =
      algebraMap ℚ M.K (q' - q) := by rw [map_sub]; ring
  have hsum0 : (t - algebraMap ℚ M.K q) + -(t - algebraMap ℚ M.K q') ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hsum, Ne, map_eq_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℚ M.K).injective, sub_eq_zero]
    exact Ne.symm hne
  have := (P q).min_le_ord_add hsum0
  rw [hsum, Place.ord_algebraMap_rat, Place.ord_neg] at this
  omega

/-- The existing genuine Riemann polar-realization input gives the source's
simple-zero function. No new Belyi existence assertion is used here. -/
theorem simpleZeroFunction_of_polarRealization
    (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (hRealize : ∃ N1 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor M, 0 ≤ A → N1 ≤ divisorDegree M A →
      ∃ f : M.K, ∀ P : Place M.K, poleMultiplicity M hDVR f P = A P)
    (T : Finset (Place M.K)) : Nonempty (SimpleZeroFunction M hDVR T) := by
  classical
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  letI := model_infinite_places M
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := hRealize
  obtain ⟨T', hTT', hcard⟩ :=
    Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq T (T.card + N1.toNat + 1) (by omega)
  let A : Divisor M := ∑ P ∈ T', Finsupp.single P 1
  have hA : ∀ P, A P = if P ∈ T' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro P
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := fun P => by rw [hA]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hdeg : N1 ≤ divisorDegree M A := by
    have h1 : divisorDegree M A = ∑ P ∈ T', (P.degree : ℤ) := by
      change divisorDegreeHom M A = _
      dsimp only [A]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [divisorDegreeHom, divisorDegree_single]
    have h2 : ∑ P ∈ T', (1 : ℤ) ≤ ∑ P ∈ T', (P.degree : ℤ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun P _ => by exact_mod_cast P.degree_pos
    rw [Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h2
    push_cast at h2
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hN1 A hA0 hdeg
  let ψ := f⁻¹
  have hSimple : ∀ P ∈ T', ord M hDVR P ψ = 1 := by
    intro P hP
    have := hf P
    simp only [poleMultiplicity, hA P, if_pos hP] at this
    simp only [ψ, ord_eq_placeOrd, Place.ord_inv] at this ⊢
    omega
  have hNoZeros : ∀ P ∉ T', ord M hDVR P ψ ≤ 0 := by
    intro P hP
    have := hf P
    simp only [poleMultiplicity, hA P, if_neg hP] at this
    simp only [ψ, ord_eq_placeOrd, Place.ord_inv] at this ⊢
    omega
  have hne : T'.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ := hne
  have hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ := by
    intro ha
    have hz := P0.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic ha
    have ho := hSimple P0 hP0
    simp only [ord_eq_placeOrd] at ho
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨ψ, hψ, T', hTT', ⟨P0, hP0⟩, hSimple, hNoZeros⟩⟩

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

nodes.theorem_title: Actual values and ramification under one rational elementary map
nodes.formal_statement:
/-- OPEN: the actual single-elementary-map composition step from the source.
The map is a rational Möbius transformation with nonzero determinant or a
positive-degree rational polynomial. Every actual residue embedding is kept. -/
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (h : NoncriticalP1.ElemMap) :
    Transcendental ℚ (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) ∧
    noncriticalValue M x (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) = h.apply (noncriticalValue M x ψ) ∧
    ramIdx M hDVR (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) x.P =
      ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P * (h.ramIdx (noncriticalValue M x ψ) : ℤ) := by
  sorry
nodes.natural_language_statement:
> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification`

Let N be a natural number and M : Model N. Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. An algebraic point x consists of any such place P and any ring embedding σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄, where ℚ̄ is the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ. Its value z_x(f) is σ(res_P(f)) if f ∈ O_P, and ∞ otherwise. Thus all places, the full residue fields, and every residue-field embedding are retained. An elementary map h is either a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), with a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0, or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] of positive natural degree. Its field action h_K uses this rational expression or p(f). The field division is total: a zero denominator gives 0. This differs from the projective rule below, where a finite point with zero denominator is sent to ∞. On ℙ¹(ℚ̄), a Möbius map sends a finite z with cz+d=0 to ∞ and otherwise to (az+b)/(cz+d); it sends ∞ to ∞ if c=0 and to a/c otherwise. A polynomial sends finite z to p(z) and ∞ to ∞. Its natural-number local index e_h(z) is 1 for a Möbius map, deg(p) for a polynomial at ∞, and the root multiplicity of z in p(X)−p(z) over ℚ̄ for a polynomial at finite z. For each ψ transcendental over ℚ, each algebraic point x=(P,σ), and each elementary h, the statement asserts the conjunction: h_K(ψ) is transcendental over ℚ; z_x(h_K(ψ)) = h(z_x(ψ)); and e_P(h_K(ψ)) = e_P(ψ) · (e_h(z_x(ψ)) : ℤ). The natural local index is explicitly cast to an integer, so this last equality is an equality and product in ℤ. It is postcomposition of ψ by h: first ψ, then h. Input transcendence is required, while output transcendence is part of the conclusion; there is no extra hypothesis that a Möbius denominator is nonzero, no restriction to rational residue values, and no independently assumed chain rule.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification`

设 N 为自然数，M : Model N。也就是说，M.K 是 ℚ(t) 的代数闭包中的中间域，带有元素 u、v，满足 u 在 ℚ 上超越，u^N + v^N = 1，ℚ(u,v) = M.K，且 M.K 是 ℚ(u) 的 N 次有限扩张。设 hDVR 表示每个处的赋值环都是离散赋值环。处 P 是 M.K 中包含 ℚ 且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P；这里没有仿射开集限制。记 κ(P) 为它的完整剩余域，res_P : O_P → κ(P) 为实际剩余映射。整数 ord_P 是规范化离散阶，并约定 ord_P(0) = 0。对任意 f ∈ M.K，若 f ∈ O_P，令 q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f))，并定义整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))；若 f ∉ O_P，则定义 e_P(f) = −ord_P(f)。这正是 ramIdx M hDVR f P 的定义。代数点 x 由任意这样的处 P 以及任意环嵌入 σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄ 组成，其中 ℚ̄ 是固定的 ℚ 的代数闭包。若 f ∈ O_P，则它的值为 z_x(f) = σ(res_P(f))；否则值为 ∞。因此，这里保留所有处、完整剩余域以及每一个剩余域嵌入。初等映射 h 或者是有理系数的 Möbius 变换 (az+b)/(cz+d)，其中 a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ 且 ad−bc ≠ 0；或者是正自然次数的多项式 p ∈ ℚ[X]。它在域上的作用 h_K 使用这一有理式或 p(f)。这里的域除法处处有定义：分母为零时商为零。这与下述射影直线上的规则不同，后者把分母为零的有限点映到 ∞。在 ℙ¹(ℚ̄) 上，Möbius 变换把满足 cz+d=0 的有限点 z 映到 ∞，把其他有限点映到 (az+b)/(cz+d)；若 c=0，则把 ∞ 映到 ∞，否则映到 a/c。多项式把有限点 z 映到 p(z)，把 ∞ 映到 ∞。自然数值的局部分歧指数 e_h(z) 定义如下：Möbius 变换处处为 1；多项式在 ∞ 处为 deg(p)，在有限点 z 处为 ℚ̄ 上多项式 p(X)−p(z) 的根 z 的重数。对每个在 ℚ 上超越的 ψ、每个代数点 x=(P,σ) 和每个初等映射 h，陈述同时要求：h_K(ψ) 在 ℚ 上超越；z_x(h_K(ψ)) = h(z_x(ψ))；以及 e_P(h_K(ψ)) = e_P(ψ) · (e_h(z_x(ψ)) : ℤ)。自然数值的局部分歧指数在最后一个等式中显式转换为整数，所以这是 ℤ 中的等式和乘法。复合方向是在 ψ 之后施加 h，即先 ψ、后 h。输入的超越性是假设，输出的超越性是结论的一部分；没有额外假设 Möbius 变换的分母非零，没有将剩余值限制为有理数，也没有另行假设链式法则。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification`

N を自然数、M : Model N とする。M.K は ℚ(t) の代数閉包の中間体であり、元 u、v は、u が ℚ 上超越的、u^N + v^N = 1、ℚ(u,v) = M.K、かつ M.K が ℚ(u) 上 N 次の有限拡大という条件を満たす。hDVR は、すべての付値点の付値環が離散付値環であることを表す。付値点 P は、ℚ を含み M.K 全体とは異なる付値部分環 O_P であり、アフィン開集合への制限はない。κ(P) はその剰余体全体、res_P : O_P → κ(P) は実際の剰余写像である。整数 ord_P は正規化された離散位数であり、ord_P(0) = 0 と定める。f ∈ M.K に対し、f ∈ O_P ならば q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)) として整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))、f ∉ O_P ならば e_P(f) = −ord_P(f) と定める。これが ramIdx M hDVR f P の定義である。代数点 x は、任意のこのような付値点 P と任意の環埋め込み σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄ の組である。ここで ℚ̄ は固定された ℚ の代数閉包である。f ∈ O_P ならば値を z_x(f) = σ(res_P(f))、それ以外ならば ∞ とする。したがって、すべての付値点、剰余体全体、およびすべての剰余体埋め込みを対象としている。初等写像 h は、有理数係数の Möbius 変換 (az+b)/(cz+d)（a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ、ad−bc ≠ 0）、または正の自然次数をもつ多項式 p ∈ ℚ[X] である。体上の作用 h_K は、この有理式または p(f) によって定まる。この体での除法は全域で定義されており、分母が零ならば商は 0 である。これは、分母が零である有限点を ∞ に写す、以下の射影直線上の規則とは異なる。ℙ¹(ℚ̄) 上では、Möbius 変換は cz+d=0 を満たす有限点 z を ∞ に、それ以外の有限点を (az+b)/(cz+d) に写す。また、c=0 ならば ∞ を ∞ に、それ以外ならば a/c に写す。多項式は有限点 z を p(z) に、∞ を ∞ に写す。自然数値の局所分岐指数 e_h(z) は、Möbius 変換では常に 1、多項式の ∞ では deg(p)、多項式の有限点 z では ℚ̄ 上の多項式 p(X)−p(z) における根 z の重複度である。ℚ 上超越的な各 ψ、各代数点 x=(P,σ)、各初等写像 h に対し、主張は次の三つの連言である。h_K(ψ) は ℚ 上超越的である。z_x(h_K(ψ)) = h(z_x(ψ)) が成り立つ。さらに e_P(h_K(ψ)) = e_P(ψ) · (e_h(z_x(ψ)) : ℤ) が成り立つ。最後の式では自然数値の局所分岐指数を明示的に整数へ変換しており、等式と積はいずれも ℤ 内のものである。合成の向きは ψ の後に h を作用させる向き、すなわち先に ψ、次に h である。入力の超越性は仮定であり、出力の超越性は結論に含まれる。Möbius 変換の分母の非零性を追加の仮定として要求せず、剰余値を有理数に制限せず、連鎖律を別途仮定していない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ord_natCast`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。P をこのような任意の素点とする。任意の自然数 n に対し、ord_P(n)=0 である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ord_algebraMap`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。P をこのような任意の素点とする。有理数体上代数的な任意の標数零の体 F、K の指定された任意の F 代数構造、および任意の c∈F に対し、c の K における像の位数は零である。

import Definitions.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.AdicValuation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.Dvr
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.Discrete.IsDiscreteValuationRing

/-!
# Places of a curve field

A *place* of a field `K` is a valuation subring `O ⊊ K` containing `ℚ` (the condition
`ℚ ⊆ O` excludes e.g. the Gauss extension of a `p`-adic valuation of `ℚ` to `ℚ(t)`).
For a curve field `K` (`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField`) the places are the closed points of
the regular proper model of the curve, and they are described by the affine *charts*
`A_t = chartRing t`: for `t` transcendental, the places containing `t` are exactly the
localisations of the Dedekind domain `A_t` at its height-one primes
(`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.chartEquiv`); every place contains `t` or `t⁻¹`.

## Main definitions

* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place K`: the places of `K`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ord P : K → ℤ`: the normalised discrete valuation at `P`
  (with the junk value `ord 0 = 0`).
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ResidueField P`: the residue field, a number field.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.deg P`: the degree `[κ(P) : ℚ]`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.chartEquiv t`: places containing `t` ≃ height-one primes of `A_t`.

## Main results

* `IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1`; the valuation laws for `ord`; uniformisers.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.finite_setOf_ord_ne_zero`,
  `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.finite_setOf_notMem`: finiteness of zeros and poles.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.exists_ord_pos`, `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.exists_ord_neg`: a
  transcendental element has a zero and a pole;
  `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.isAlgebraic_of_forall_mem`: an element lying in every place is
  algebraic over `ℚ`.
-/

open IsDedekindDomain IsLocalRing
open scoped IntermediateField WithZero

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

section Abstract

/-! ### Valuation subrings dominating a Dedekind domain -/

variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra R K]

/-- The prime of `R` lying below a valuation subring `O` containing (the image of) `R`. -/
def primeBelow (O : ValuationSubring K) (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : Ideal R :=
  (maximalIdeal O).comap ((algebraMap R K).codRestrict O hR)

theorem mem_primeBelow {O : ValuationSubring K} {hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O} {r : R} :
    r ∈ primeBelow O hR ↔ algebraMap R K r ∈ O.nonunits := by
  rw [primeBelow, Ideal.mem_comap, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  rfl

instance (O : ValuationSubring K) (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    (primeBelow O hR).IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _

section Domain

variable [IsDomain R]

theorem primeBelow_ne_bot [IsFractionRing R K] {O : ValuationSubring K} (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : primeBelow O hR ≠ ⊥ := by
  intro h
  apply hO
  refine top_unique fun x _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) x
  have hb0 : algebraMap R K b ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb
  have hbn : algebraMap R K b ∉ O.nonunits := by
    rw [← mem_primeBelow (hR := hR), h, Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hb0 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hbn
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact O.mul_mem _ _ (hR a) hbn.2

/-- The height-one prime of `R` below a valuation subring `O ≠ K` containing `R`. -/
def heightOneBelow [IsFractionRing R K] (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : HeightOneSpectrum R :=
  ⟨primeBelow O hR, inferInstance, primeBelow_ne_bot hO hR⟩

theorem mem_heightOneBelow [IsFractionRing R K] {O : ValuationSubring K} {hO : O ≠ ⊤}
    {hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O} {r : R} :
    r ∈ (heightOneBelow O hO hR).asIdeal ↔ algebraMap R K r ∈ O.nonunits :=
  mem_primeBelow

end Domain

variable [IsDedekindDomain R] [IsFractionRing R K]

theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_le (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K (heightOneBelow O hO hR) ≤ O := by
  rintro x ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩
  have hsn : algebraMap R K s ∉ O.nonunits := by
    rw [← mem_primeBelow (hR := hR)]; exact hs
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hsn
  exact O.mul_mem _ _ (hR a) hsn.2

/-- A valuation subring `O ≠ K` containing a Dedekind domain `R` with fraction field `K` is
the localisation of `R` at the prime below `O`. -/
theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K (heightOneBelow O hO hR) = O :=
  ValuationSubring.eq_of_le_of_ne_top _ (valuationSubringAtPrime_le O hO hR) hO

instance (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v) :=
  IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain R v.ne_bot _

theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_of_le (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : IsDiscreteValuationRing O := by
  rw [← valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow O hO hR]; infer_instance

theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v ≠ ⊤ := by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring, ne_eq,
    Valuation.valuationSubring_eq_top_iff, not_not]
  infer_instance

theorem algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) :
    algebraMap R K r ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v := by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
  exact HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_le_one _ _

theorem heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    heightOneBelow (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v)
      (valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top v) (algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v) = v := by
  ext r
  rw [mem_heightOneBelow, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff,
    ← HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem (K := K),
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring]
  exact (Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring _).symm.lt_one_iff_lt_one

/-- The residue map of `O` restricted to a Dedekind domain `R ⊆ O` with fraction field `K`
is surjective (the residue field of `O` is `R ⧸ 𝔭`). -/
theorem residue_comp_surjective (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    Function.Surjective ((residue O).comp ((algebraMap R K).codRestrict O hR)) := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hxO⟩, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective y
  have hx := hxO
  rw [← valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow O hO hR] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, s, hs, hxas⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, i, hi, hbi⟩ := (heightOneBelow O hO hR).isMaximal.exists_inv hs
  refine ⟨a * b, ?_⟩
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, residue_eq_zero_iff,
    ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hs0 : algebraMap R K s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hs
    rw [(IsFractionRing.injective R K) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  have hin : algebraMap R K i ∈ O.nonunits := mem_heightOneBelow.mp hi
  have key : x - algebraMap R K (a * b) = x * algebraMap R K i := by
    have hbi' : algebraMap R K b * algebraMap R K s + algebraMap R K i = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_add, hbi, map_one]
    rw [hxas, map_mul, show algebraMap R K i = 1 - algebraMap R K b * algebraMap R K s by
      rw [← hbi']; ring]
    field_simp
  change x - algebraMap R K (a * b) ∈ O.nonunits
  rw [key, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff, map_mul]
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff] at hin
  calc O.valuation x * O.valuation (algebraMap R K i) < 1 * 1 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos ((O.valuation_le_one_iff x).mpr hxO) hin
          zero_le zero_lt_one
    _ = 1 := one_mul 1

end Abstract

/-! ### Places -/

/- The actual Place carrier is already defined in Def_FermatProperCarrier. -/

namespace Place

variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

@[ext]
theorem ext {P Q : Place K} (h : P.1 = Q.1) : P = Q := Subtype.ext h

theorem ne_top (P : Place K) : P.1 ≠ ⊤ := P.2.1

theorem ratCast_mem (P : Place K) (q : ℚ) : (q : K) ∈ P.1 := P.2.2 q

theorem mem_or_inv_mem (P : Place K) (x : K) : x ∈ P.1 ∨ x⁻¹ ∈ P.1 := P.1.mem_or_inv_mem x

variable [CharZero K]

theorem algebraMap_mem (P : Place K) (q : ℚ) : algebraMap ℚ K q ∈ P.1 := P.ratCast_mem q

/-- Elements of `K` integral over `ℚ` (the constants) lie in every place. -/
theorem mem_of_isIntegral (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsIntegral ℚ x) : x ∈ P.1 := by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1.toSubring K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1 K)
  have hle : (integralClosure ℚ K).toSubring ≤ P.1.toSubring :=
    Subring.integralClosure_le_iff.mpr P.algebraMap_mem
  exact hle hx

theorem mem_of_isAlgebraic (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic ℚ x) : x ∈ P.1 :=
  P.mem_of_isIntegral hx.isIntegral

theorem inv_mem_of_isAlgebraic (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic ℚ x) : x⁻¹ ∈ P.1 :=
  P.mem_of_isAlgebraic hx.inv

/-! ### Charts -/

section Chart

variable [IsCurveField K] (t : K) [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)]

omit [IsCurveField K] [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] in
theorem algebraMap_chartRing_mem (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) (r : chartRing t) :
    algebraMap (chartRing t) K r ∈ P.1 :=
  mem_of_mem_chartRing P.1 P.ratCast_mem ht r.2

/-- The height-one prime of the chart ring `A_t` below a place containing `t`. -/
noncomputable def toChart (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t) :=
  heightOneBelow P.1 P.ne_top (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t ht)

theorem mem_toChart_iff (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) {r : chartRing t} :
    r ∈ (P.toChart t ht).asIdeal ↔ (r : K) ∈ P.1.nonunits :=
  mem_heightOneBelow

/-- The place of `K` given by the localisation of `A_t` at a height-one prime. -/
noncomputable def ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) : Place K :=
  ⟨HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v, valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top v,
    fun q ↦ algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v ⟨q, ratCast_mem_chartRing t q⟩⟩

theorem ofChart_val (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    (ofChart t v).1 = HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v := rfl

theorem self_mem_ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) : t ∈ (ofChart t v).1 :=
  algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v ⟨t, self_mem_chartRing t⟩

@[simp]
theorem ofChart_toChart (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) : ofChart t (P.toChart t ht) = P :=
  Place.ext (valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow _ _ _)

@[simp]
theorem toChart_ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    (ofChart t v).toChart t (self_mem_ofChart t v) = v :=
  heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime v

/-- The places containing `t` correspond to the height-one primes of the chart ring `A_t`
(the place is the localisation of `A_t` at the prime). -/
noncomputable def chartEquiv : {P : Place K // t ∈ P.1} ≃ HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t) where
  toFun P := P.1.toChart t P.2
  invFun v := ⟨ofChart t v, self_mem_ofChart t v⟩
  left_inv P := Subtype.ext (ofChart_toChart t P.1 P.2)
  right_inv v := toChart_ofChart t v

theorem residue_comp_surjective (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) :
    Function.Surjective ((IsLocalRing.residue P.1).comp
      ((algebraMap (chartRing t) K).codRestrict P.1 (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t ht))) :=
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.residue_comp_surjective P.1 P.ne_top _

end Chart

section DVR

variable [IsCurveField K]

/-- Every place contains a transcendental element (namely `t` or `t⁻¹` for any
transcendental `t`). -/
theorem exists_transcendental_mem (P : Place K) : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ t ∈ P.1 := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  rcases P.mem_or_inv_mem t with h | h
  · exact ⟨t, ht, h⟩
  · exact ⟨t⁻¹, transcendental_inv ht, h⟩

instance isDiscreteValuationRing (P : Place K) : IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1 := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htP⟩ := P.exists_transcendental_mem
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  exact isDiscreteValuationRing_of_le P.1 P.ne_top (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP)

/-- The normalised discrete valuation of `K` at the place `P`, with values in `ℤᵐ⁰`. -/
noncomputable def valuation (P : Place K) : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰ :=
  (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation K

/-- The order of vanishing `ord_P f ∈ ℤ` of `f` at the place `P` (junk value `ord_P 0 = 0`). -/
noncomputable def ord (P : Place K) (f : K) : ℤ := -WithZero.log (P.valuation f)

variable (P : Place K) {f g : K}

@[simp]
theorem valuation_eq_zero_iff : P.valuation f = 0 ↔ f = 0 := Valuation.zero_iff _

theorem valuation_ne_zero (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.valuation f ≠ 0 := by simpa using hf

theorem valuation_eq_exp (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.valuation f = WithZero.exp (-P.ord f) := by
  rw [ord, neg_neg, WithZero.exp_log (P.valuation_ne_zero hf)]

@[simp]
theorem ord_zero : P.ord 0 = 0 := by simp [ord]

@[simp]
theorem ord_one : P.ord 1 = 0 := by simp [ord]

theorem ord_mul (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : P.ord (f * g) = P.ord f + P.ord g := by
  simp only [ord, map_mul, WithZero.log_mul (P.valuation_ne_zero hf) (P.valuation_ne_zero hg)]
  ring

@[simp]
theorem ord_inv (f : K) : P.ord f⁻¹ = -P.ord f := by
  simp [ord, map_inv₀, WithZero.log_inv]

@[simp]
theorem ord_pow (f : K) (n : ℕ) : P.ord (f ^ n) = n * P.ord f := by
  simp [ord, map_pow, WithZero.log_pow]

@[simp]
theorem ord_zpow (f : K) (n : ℤ) : P.ord (f ^ n) = n * P.ord f := by
  simp [ord, map_zpow₀, WithZero.log_zpow]

theorem ord_div (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : P.ord (f / g) = P.ord f - P.ord g := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, P.ord_mul hf (inv_ne_zero hg), ord_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]

@[simp]
theorem ord_neg (f : K) : P.ord (-f) = P.ord f := by simp [ord]

theorem mem_iff_valuation_le_one : f ∈ P.1 ↔ P.valuation f ≤ 1 := by
  have := IsDiscreteValuationRing.map_algebraMap_eq_valuationSubring (A := P.1) (K := K)
  change _ ↔ f ∈ (P.valuation.valuationSubring.toSubring)
  rw [valuation, ← this]
  simp

theorem mem_iff_ord_nonneg : f ∈ P.1 ↔ f = 0 ∨ 0 ≤ P.ord f := by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp [P.1.zero_mem]
  rw [mem_iff_valuation_le_one, P.valuation_eq_exp hf, ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_le_exp]
  simp [hf]

theorem ord_nonneg_of_mem (hf : f ∈ P.1) : 0 ≤ P.ord f := by
  rcases (P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg).mp hf with rfl | h
  · simp
  · exact h

theorem mem_of_ord_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ P.ord f) : f ∈ P.1 :=
  (P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg).mpr (Or.inr hf)

theorem ord_neg_iff : P.ord f < 0 ↔ f ∉ P.1 := by
  rw [P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, not_or, not_le]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, h⟩
    subst h0
    simp at h
  · exact fun h ↦ h.2

/-- For `a ∈ O_P` nonzero, `ord_P a > 0` iff `a` lies in the maximal ideal. -/
theorem ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal {a : P.1} (ha : (a : K) ≠ 0) :
    0 < P.ord a ↔ a ∈ maximalIdeal P.1 := by
  have h := HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1) (K := K) a
  change P.valuation a < 1 ↔ a ∈ maximalIdeal P.1 at h
  rw [← h, P.valuation_eq_exp ha, ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_lt_exp, Left.neg_neg_iff]

theorem ord_pos_iff : 0 < P.ord f ↔ f ≠ 0 ∧ f ∈ P.1.nonunits := by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp
  simp only [ne_eq, hf, not_false_eq_true, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : f ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg h.le
    have := (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨f, hm⟩) hf).mp h
    exact ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mpr this
  · intro h
    have hm : f ∈ P.1 := P.1.nonunits_subset h
    exact (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨f, hm⟩) hf).mpr
      (ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp h)

theorem ord_eq_zero_iff (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.ord f = 0 ↔ f ∈ P.1 ∧ f⁻¹ ∈ P.1 := by
  rw [P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, ord_inv]
  simp only [hf, inv_eq_zero, false_or, Left.nonneg_neg_iff]
  omega

theorem min_le_ord_add (hfg : f + g ≠ 0) : min (P.ord f) (P.ord g) ≤ P.ord (f + g) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne g 0 with rfl | hg
  · simp
  have h := P.valuation.map_add f g
  rw [P.valuation_eq_exp hf, P.valuation_eq_exp hg, P.valuation_eq_exp hfg] at h
  rcases le_total (P.ord f) (P.ord g) with hle | hle
  · rw [max_eq_left (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hle)), WithZero.exp_le_exp] at h
    rw [min_eq_left hle]; omega
  · rw [max_eq_right (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hle)), WithZero.exp_le_exp] at h
    rw [min_eq_right hle]; omega

theorem ord_add_eq_of_lt (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) (h : P.ord f < P.ord g) :
    P.ord (f + g) = P.ord f := by
  have hv : P.valuation g < P.valuation f := by
    rw [P.valuation_eq_exp hf, P.valuation_eq_exp hg, WithZero.exp_lt_exp]; omega
  have := P.valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_left hv
  rw [ord, ord, this]

/-- Every place has a uniformiser. -/
theorem exists_ord_eq_one : ∃ π : K, P.ord π = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_exists_uniformizer K
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1)
  refine ⟨π, ?_⟩
  change -WithZero.log (P.valuation π) = 1
  rw [show P.valuation π = WithZero.exp (-1) from hπ, WithZero.log_exp, neg_neg]

/-- Constants (elements algebraic over `ℚ`) have order `0` at every place. -/
theorem ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic {c : K} (hc : IsAlgebraic ℚ c) : P.ord c = 0 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · simp
  exact (P.ord_eq_zero_iff hc0).mpr ⟨P.mem_of_isAlgebraic hc, P.inv_mem_of_isAlgebraic hc⟩

@[simp]
theorem ord_ratCast (q : ℚ) : P.ord (q : K) = 0 :=
  P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic (isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := ℚ) q)

@[simp]
theorem ord_algebraMap_rat (q : ℚ) : P.ord (algebraMap ℚ K q) = 0 := P.ord_ratCast q

@[simp]
theorem ord_natCast (n : ℕ) : P.ord (n : K) = 0 := by
  simpa using P.ord_ratCast n

/-- Elements of an algebraic extension `F` of `ℚ` inside `K` (constants) have order `0`. -/
theorem ord_algebraMap {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ F] (c : F) : P.ord (algebraMap F K c) = 0 :=
  P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic
    ((Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := ℚ) c).algHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ F K))

end DVR

end Place

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationFinite`

Let N be any natural number and M a given Model(N). This does not assert that such a model exists for every N. Its field K=M.K is an intermediate field over ℚ in an algebraic closure of ℚ(X). It has specified elements u,v with u transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, and ℚ(u,v)=K. The extension K/ℚ(u) is finite-dimensional with dimension N. A place P of K is an actual valuation subring O_P⊊K containing every rational number. The carrier includes every such subring; it selects no affine chart. Membership f∈O_P is the source meaning of f being regular at P. A pole here means f∉O_P. The derivative D_ψ is the actual function CurveDeriv.derivAlong(ψ), not an arbitrary supplied derivation. For a characteristic-zero field K and ψ∈K, this function tests whether ψ is transcendental over ℚ and K is algebraic over ℚ(ψ). If both hold, it takes the formal polynomial derivative on ℚ[ψ] and extends it to K through the canonical Kähler differential equivalence for the formally étale extension ℚ[ψ]→K. If the conjunction fails, D_ψ is the zero derivation. Assume hDVR: every place ring O_P is a discrete valuation ring. Write o_P(f) for the exact order ord(M,hDVR,P,f) in the source. It is −WithZero.log(v_P(f)), where v_P is the valuation attached to the maximal ideal of that discrete valuation ring. The integer e_ψ(P)=ramIdx(M,hDVR,ψ,P) is defined by two cases. If ψ∈O_P, take the residue ψ̄ in the residue field of O_P and set e_ψ(P)=o_P(minpoly_ℚ(ψ̄)(ψ)). If ψ∉O_P, set e_ψ(P)=−o_P(ψ). The minimal polynomial is evaluated at the actual field element ψ. No ramification law is an extra parameter. Let ψ∈K be transcendental over ℚ. Then the set of all places P of K with 1<e_ψ(P) is finite, where e_ψ(P) is the actual integer index defined above. The quantifier includes every place, with no restriction to an affine chart or to places where ψ is regular. The written proof puts this set inside the union of two finite sets: the pole set {P:ψ∉O_P}, and the derivative-failure set {P:ψ∈O_P and there exists s∈O_P with D_ψ(s)∉O_P}. At a place in the first case, pole finiteness applies. At a place in the second case, the local derivative-obstruction child supplies the witness s. The existing curve-field theorem gives pole finiteness from Model; the other finite set is exactly the finite-failure child. The parent has a written combination proof, but that proof depends on both open sorry children. No complete proof of finite ramification is claimed by this source package.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationFinite`

> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochEventuallyLinear`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). There exist integers g₀,N₀ such that every divisor A with deg(A)≥N₀ satisfies ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀ over ℤ. The same two constants apply to all such divisors A.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochEventuallyLinear`

对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。另给定证明 hDVR，断言每个处 P 的赋值环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。对每个除子 A，定义有理数线性子空间 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 或每个处 P 都满足 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，并记 ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。存在整数 g₀,N₀，使每个满足 deg(A)≥N₀ 的除子 A 都满足整数等式 ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀。同一对常数适用于所有这样的除子 A。

Let N be a natural number and M : Model N. Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. An algebraic point x consists of any such place P and any ring embedding σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄, where ℚ̄ is the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ. Its value z_x(f) is σ(res_P(f)) if f ∈ O_P, and ∞ otherwise. Thus all places, the full residue fields, and every residue-field embedding are retained. An elementary map h is either a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), with a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0, or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] of positive natural degree. Its field action h_K uses this rational expression or p(f). The field division is total: a zero denominator gives 0. This differs from the projective rule below, where a finite point with zero denominator is sent to ∞. On ℙ¹(ℚ̄), a Möbius map sends a finite z with cz+d=0 to ∞ and otherwise to (az+b)/(cz+d); it sends ∞ to ∞ if c=0 and to a/c otherwise. A polynomial sends finite z to p(z) and ∞ to ∞. Its natural-number local index e_h(z) is 1 for a Möbius map, deg(p) for a polynomial at ∞, and the root multiplicity of z in p(X)−p(z) over ℚ̄ for a polynomial at finite z. For a list hs=[h₁,…,hₙ], H_K(ψ)=compK hs ψ means hₙ,K(…h₂,K(h₁,K(ψ))…), and H(z)=evalComp hs z means hₙ(…h₂(h₁(z))…). Thus the head of the list acts first. Put z₀=z and zᵢ=hᵢ(zᵢ₋₁); E_hs(z)=ramIdxComp hs z is the natural-number product ∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ e_hᵢ(zᵢ₋₁). For the empty list these are ψ, z, and 1. > “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.
**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree_eq_sum_of_support_subset`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ between $ℚ$ and an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, and elements $u,v∈K$, such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$ (no nonzero polynomial over $ℚ$ vanishes at $u$), $u^N+v^N=1$, the subfield generated by $ℚ,u,v$ is $K$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over the subfield $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. There is no separate restriction on $N$; the assertion concerns supplied data satisfying all these conditions. For $N=0$ the equation would be $1+1=1$ in characteristic zero, so no such model is supplied and assertions conditional on it are vacuous. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; $κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ is its residue field. A divisor $A$ means a finitely supported integer-valued function on all places; inequalities and addition of divisors are coefficientwise. Its degree is $\deg A=\sum_P A(P)d_P$, where $d_P=[κ(P):ℚ]$ is the finite rational vector-space dimension. Write $[P]$ for the divisor with coefficient one at $P$ and zero elsewhere. For every divisor $A$ and finite set $s$ of places containing its support $\{P:A(P)≠0\}$, $\deg A=\sum_{P∈s}A(P)d_P$. The coefficients of $A$ may be negative, $s$ may contain extra zero-coefficient places, and the statement includes the empty support.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionZeroDivisor_degree`

For $N=0$ the equation would be $1+1=1$ in characteristic zero, so no such model is supplied and assertions conditional on it are vacuous. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; $κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ is its residue field. Assume $h_{DVR}$: every such $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring. Write $v_P(f)$ for minus the integer logarithm of its maximal-ideal valuation at $f$, the normalized integer order with the total-function convention $v_P(0)=0$. A divisor $A$ means a finitely supported integer-valued function on all places; inequalities and addition of divisors are coefficientwise. Its degree is $\deg A=\sum_P A(P)d_P$, where $d_P=[κ(P):ℚ]$ is the finite rational vector-space dimension. Write $[P]$ for the divisor with coefficient one at $P$ and zero elsewhere. **日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree_eq_sum_of_support_subset`

$N$ を自然数とし、$M$ は $ℚ$ と $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包との間の中間体 $K$ および $u,v∈K$ からなるとする。$u$ は $ℚ$ 上超越的（$u$ で零になる零でない有理係数多項式はない）であり、$u^N+v^N=1$、$ℚ,u,v$ が生成する部分体は $K$ 全体であり、$K$ は部分体 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限次元で次元はちょうど $N$ である。$N$ への別の制限はなく、主張はこれらすべての条件を満たす与えられたデータについて述べる。$N=0$ なら方程式は標数零の体で $1+1=1$ となるため、そのようなモデルは存在せず、それを仮定する主張は空虚に成立する。 素点 $P$ とはすべての有理数を含む真の付値部分環 $O_P⊊K$ をいい、$κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P$ をその剰余体とする。 因子 $A$ とはすべての素点上の有限台整数値関数をいい、因子の不等式と加法は係数ごとに計算する。次数は $\deg A=\sum_P A(P)d_P$ であり、$d_P=[κ(P):ℚ]$ は有限な有理ベクトル空間次元である。$[P]$ は $P$ での係数が一、他では零の因子とする。 任意の因子 $A$ と、その台 $\{P:A(P)≠0\}$ を含む任意の素点の有限集合 $s$ に対し、$\deg A=\sum_{P∈s}A(P)d_P$ である。$A$ の係数は負でもよく、$s$ は係数が零の素点を余分に含んでもよい。空の台も含む。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionZeroDivisor_degree`
